results.title: INDIA bloc’s ‘public impeachment’ of CEC postponed by a day; Chalo Dilli march on November 1
results.content: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi alleges Home Minister is trying his best to prevent people from reaching Delhi for the rally

results.title: Delhi’s Kotla Firoz Shah becomes a courtroom for faith, doubt and belief
results.content: In Delhi’s Kotla Firoz Shah, devotees visit a 14th-Century fort each Thursday to petition the fort’s resident djinns at Hawa Mahal, offering sugar, incense, and handwritten pleas in hopes of relief from personal troubles

results.title: Air Force Sports Complex shut as Centre moves to reclaim prime land in Delhi
results.content: The closure comes days after the Land and Development Office issued notices to the facility to hand over the land located on Lok Kalyan Marg.

results.title: Delhi SIR: Poll body to step up door-to-door re-verification of 47.5 lakh deleted voters
results.content: Senior officials said special camps for voter enrolment, including students, homeless, transgender persons and sex workers, were also being considered for November 15 and 22

results.title: Ex-bureaucrat moves Delhi High Court against ‘large-scale’ CAPF deployment during protests
results.content: The PIL seeks directions to the authorities to disclose details of requisitions made by the Delhi Police and the sanction and extension order of the Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)
